title: Desi Masala Omelette
steps: Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk vigorously until frothy.
Add chopped onions, tomatoes, green chilies, red chili powder, turmeric, and salt. Mix well.
Melt butter in a non-stick frying pan over medium-low heat.
Pour the egg mixture evenly into the pan. Let it cook undisturbed for 2-3 minutes.
Carefully fold the omelette in half. Cook for another minute until the inside is just set.
Serve hot with crispy toast or paratha.
